author: Sydney Stern
title: Quarter zips required in the 4th quarter - NewsBreak
text:
By Sydney Stern ,
14 hours ago This just in, there is a new dress code being implemented at WCHS. Say goodbye to the days of sweatpants and hoodies, and hello to quarterzips, sweaters and matcha. According to completely “reliable sources” who definitely did not overhear this conversation in the hallway, the administration has decided that students have grown far too attached to the dangerous freedom of dressing like they rolled out of bed five minutes before first period. The new policy seeks to restore WCHS to a sophisticated school. Read full article
